subject: Recap & asks — spend controller, procurement lane, and security evidence for NovaGyro
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@novagyro.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Recap & asks — spend controller, procurement lane, and security evidence for NovaGyro

Hi Ethan — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and clear asks so we can keep momentum: 

What we heard
- Primary use: inference for real-time analytics (low-latency) in their customer dashboard.
- Pilot target: 2–4 endpoints, ~100k tokens/day, month-long evaluation.
- Success criteria: under 150ms p95 and predictable unit cost under $0.002/token.

Asks / next steps (can you confirm the owners below?):
1) Spend controller / who signs approvals: you mentioned this sits with Finance. Can you confirm the person who would sign off on the pilot PO? I believe Claire Danvers (VP Ops) is the likely approver — please confirm.
2) Procurement lane & PO: is a PO required for a pilot, and if so, are there any specific billing terms or vendor forms we should expect?
3) Security evidence: procurement typically asks for SOC 2 and data handling notes. Attached is a short security-checklist.xlsx we can fill. Can you confirm the procurement contact to send evidence to?
4) Demo + timeline: if procurement/finance are aligned, we can schedule a short technical demo for the procurement team + Claire next week. Is Tue/Wed workable?

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (call highlights), security-checklist.xlsx (intake).

If you can loop in Claire or procurement and confirm next available times, we’ll prepare a concise pilot quote + the evidence pack. Connor will take point on pricing, and Marissa will coordinate security artifacts.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad

Subject: Re: Recap & asks — spend controller, procurement lane, and security evidence for NovaGyro

Thanks Mina — great summary. Short answers below and looping in procurement (Ellie).

1) Spend controller: Claire Danvers (claire.danvers@novagyro.com) is the approver for pilots above $5k. She typically needs a short justification + estimate.
2) PO: yes, we use POs for vendor pilots of this size. Attached is our PO-policy.pdf — it covers lead times and standard payment terms (Net 30).
3) Procurement contact: Ellie is our procurement lead; she’ll list required evidence and any internal vendor forms.
4) Demo: Tue (2026-11-23) afternoon works for Claire — she prefers 30 min, high-level with pricing ballpark and SLAs.

Ellie — can you confirm what evidence you need from Redwood and whether you require an intake form filled?

Best,
Ethan

--

Subject: Re: Recap & asks — spend controller, procurement lane, and security evidence for NovaGyro

Hi Mina / Ethan — thanks for the context. Procurement checklist below: 

Required items before PO approval:
- Current SOC 2 report (or letter of attestation)
- Data processing summary (data flows and retention)
- Standard vendor intake form (I attached the PDF and also provided an intake link)
- W9 (US vendors)

If you can provide SOC 2 and a one-page data handling summary, we can proceed to an initial vendor review (1 business day). The intake link is: https://novagyro.com/procurement/intake/form/ABC123 (please paste the URL into your browser).

Timeline: once we have docs + intake, internal review typically takes 3–5 business days; Claire will schedule the signature after technical / commercial alignment.

Attachments: novagyro-intake-form-link.txt (URL stub), PO-policy.pdf (for internal reference).

Regards,
Ellie Nguyen
Procurement Lead, NovaGyro
procurement@novagyro.com

Connor / Marissa — forwarding the thread with confirmation from Ethan + procurement. Action items: 

Connor: please prepare a pilot quote (30-day pilot) with two pricing options: - fully managed demo (higher SLO) and - self-serve connection (lower cost). Include estimated token burns and a simple cancellation clause (they may request trial PO). Need draft by EOD Mon 11/22 so I can share before Claire's 11/23 slot.

Marissa: please assemble the security pack — SOC 2 letter, 1-pg data handling summary, and the filled security-checklist.xlsx. If you need a redacted SOC 2, highlight the sections procurement typically scans for (data retention, subprocessor list). Target to upload to the Drive link in this thread by Mon 11/22.

I’ll schedule the 30-min demo for Tue 11/23 2:00–2:30pm PT once Connor and Marissa confirm availability. I’ll invite Claire and Ellie.

Thanks — Mina
